mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because the final construction connected the cell parts to muscle shortening and showed that the filaments themselves keep their length.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the ribosomes and mitochondria felt somewhat repetitive as a sequence of slot-filling actions, though their pictures explained their roles.

surprise.text: The final picture clarified that the muscle unit shortens as its filaments overlap further, while each filament stays the same length.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the goals and item descriptions gave the combinations a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the final construction made me curious how these muscle cells will be organized into tissues and connected to other body systems.
